attr.title: ChooChooTracker
attr.desc: A free, open-source 8-track tracker and groovebox for handhelds, based on ChipNomad. Build songs with AY/YM and SID chips, FM, Braids and Plaits synths, Achchid acid bass, Bogie and Sintered drums, wavetables and SoundFonts. Edit and slice samples, record joystick movements, and shape sounds with modulation, track inserts and shared effects. Sync over Ableton Link and export WAV mixes or individual stems.
